description_en: On Dritan Hoxha Street, at "Lion Residence 2", we sell Apartment 2+1+2!! Lion Park 2 is an innovative and elite project, positioned at a strategic point and with immediate access to all the main areas of Tirana. The distance of 1.4 km from the center of the capital makes this project a coherent and visionary investment. Also, the infrastructure, facilities, surrounding institutions and other similar investments in the area are obvious indicators that the whole area is undergoing rapid development. The apartment is located in Rezidencen Lion 2. Information about the apartment: • Gross area: 124.61 m² • Net area: 103.84 m² • Floor 17 • Orientation - West Organization of the apartment: • Living room with kitchen • 2 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets • Laundry • 2 Balconies The building will be completed within the year 2029.
